query: SELECT u.schedule_id AS "schedule_id!", s.name AS schedule_name, u.agent_id AS "agent_id!", a.hostname, MIN(u.rank) AS "rank!" FROM (SELECT sd.schedule_id, sd.agent_id, 0 AS rank FROM schedule_dependencies sd WHERE sd.dependency_host_id = $1 UNION ALL SELECT st.schedule_id, st.agent_id, 1 FROM agent_default_dependencies ad JOIN schedule_targets st ON st.agent_id = ad.agent_id WHERE ad.dependency_host_id = $1 UNION ALL SELECT st.schedule_id, st.agent_id, 2 FROM repo_host_dependencies rd JOIN repos r ON r.repo_host_id = rd.repo_host_id JOIN schedule_repos sr ON sr.repo_id = r.id JOIN schedule_targets st ON st.schedule_id = sr.schedule_id WHERE rd.dependency_host_id = $1) u JOIN schedules s ON s.id = u.schedule_id JOIN agents a ON a.id = u.agent_id GROUP BY u.schedule_id, s.name, u.agent_id, a.hostname ORDER BY s.name, a.hostname
